about: Sabanci Holding is the parent company of the Sabanci Group, one of Turkey's biggest conglomerates, headquartered in Istanbul. Its businesses cover banking (Akbank), insurance, energy (Enerjisa), cement, retail (Carrefoursa), industry, building materials and digital ventures, operating in dozens of countries. It is listed on Borsa Istanbul (SAHOL) with the Sabanci family holding the controlling stake. Funding of about $185M was recorded in 2023. Large national conglomerate with high awareness in Turkey, and a strong record of sponsorship in sport and culture.

wiki.title: Sabancı Holding
wiki.text: Hacı Ömer Sabancı Holding A.Ş., commonly abbreviated as Sabancı Holding, is an industrial and financial conglomerate with headquarters in Istanbul, Turkey. The company's primary activities are in financial services, energy, cement, retail and industrial sectors.

about: TransUnion is a Chicago-based global information and insights company, one of the three major credit reporting agencies in the US, with credit reports, scores, identity verification, fraud prevention and marketing data. It sells to lenders, insurers, retailers and governments in about 30 countries, and consumer services through TransUnion and Credit Karma, which it acquired in 2020 for $7.1 billion. It is listed on the NYSE (TRU) with revenue near US$4 billion. Well-known name in credit reporting, and a sports partner.

wiki.title: TransUnion
wiki.text: TransUnion is an American consumer credit reporting agency. TransUnion collects and aggregates information on over one billion individual consumers in over thirty countries including "200 million files profiling nearly every credit-active consumer in the United States". Its customers include over 65,000 businesses. Based in Chicago, Illinois, TransUnion's 2014 revenue was US$1.3 billion. It is the smallest of the three largest credit agencies, along with Experian and Equifax.

about: Investec is a specialist bank and asset manager based in London and Johannesburg, dual-listed on the London and Johannesburg stock exchanges (INVP, INL). It offers private banking, wealth management, corporate and investment banking and asset management to high-income individuals and mid-sized companies, primarily in the UK and South Africa. Founded in 1974 in Johannesburg, it holds around GBP 60B of client assets. Funding of about $619M was recorded in 2021. Respected financial brand and a well-known sponsor of cricket, rugby and horse racing.

wiki.title: Investec
wiki.what: International specialist banking and asset management group
wiki.text: Investec is an Anglo-South African international banking and wealth management group, founded in Johannesburg, South Africa. It provides a range of financial products and services to a client base in Europe, Southern Africa, and Asia-Pacific.

about: Halyk Bank is Kazakhstan's largest bank by assets, based in Almaty, offering retail, SME and corporate banking, insurance, brokerage, and the Halyk app and Halyk Market online marketplace. It has millions of customers in Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan and Uzbekistan, with a large branch network, and is listed on the Kazakhstan Stock Exchange and London as HSBK. A very recognisable consumer bank in Kazakhstan, with a strong sponsorship history there.

wiki.title: Halyk Bank
wiki.text: Halyk Bank is a commercial savings bank in Kazakhstan that also has branches in Kyrgyzstan, Georgia, Russia, Tajikistan and Uzbekistan. Its full Kazakh name translates into English as "Peoples' Savings Bank of Kazakhstan Joint-Stock Company". In Russian-language sources, the bank is often referred to as Narodny sberegatelny bank Kazakhstana, the Russian equivalent of the name. The bank is the legal successor of the Soviet-era Sberbank in Kazakhstan, analogous to Sberbank in Russia. Halyk Bank is headquartered in the city of Almaty, which was the country's capital until 1997.

about: Societe Generale is one of France's largest banks, founded in 1864 and headquartered in Paris. It operates retail banking in France through SG and Boursorama, international retail units including KB in the Czech Republic and BRD in Romania, car leasing and fleet management through Ayvens, plus global investment banking, markets and asset servicing. It has well over 100,000 employees and is listed on Euronext Paris. A long-time sports and cultural sponsor, with strong brand recognition in Europe and Africa.

wiki.title: Société Générale
wiki.what: French multinational banking and financial services company
wiki.text: Société Générale S.A., colloquially known in English-speaking countries as SocGen, is a French multinational universal bank and financial services company founded in 1864. It is registered in downtown Paris and headquartered nearby in La Défense.

about: South Korean financial holding company formed in 2019 that owns Woori Bank, Woori Card, Woori Financial Capital, Woori Investment Bank and Woori Asset Management, and added life insurance units in 2024. Woori Bank traces its origins to 1899 and serves retail customers, small businesses and large corporates in Korea, with overseas branches in Asia, the US and Europe. Revenue is mainly net interest and fee income. Listed in Seoul and as an ADR in New York. Well known domestic consumer brand and already active in sports sponsorship.

wiki.title: Woori Financial Group
wiki.text: Woori Financial Group (Korean: 우리금융지주) is a Seoul-based banking and financial services holdings company and is the largest bank in South Korea.

about: South Korean financial holding company, KB Financial Group, based in Seoul and listed on the NYSE and Korea Exchange, operating KB Kookmin Bank (the largest retail bank in Korea), KB Securities, KB Insurance and KB Kookmin Card. Customers are retail and corporate clients, with assets above KRW 700 trillion. Founded 2008. Very strong domestic consumer brand and visible in sport sponsorship in Korea.

wiki.title: KB Financial Group
wiki.text: KB Financial Group Inc is a finance holding company headquartered in Seoul, South Korea. The Group and its subsidiaries provide a broad range of banking and financial services. It is one of the domestic systemically important banks (D-SIBs) identified by the Financial Services Commission.

about: China International Capital Corporation, Beijing-based investment bank founded in 1995 as a joint venture with Morgan Stanley and later owned by Central Huijin, Tencent and others. It provides investment banking, equities brokerage, asset management and wealth services, and ranks among China's leading IPO underwriters. Listed in Hong Kong (3908) and in mainland China. Brand known in finance circles rather than among the public.

AIG (American International Group) is a New York-based global insurer, founded in 1919, providing commercial and specialty property-casualty insurance, life and retirement products across about 190 countries. Revenue is around $27 billion. Listed on NYSE (AIG). Rescued by the US government in 2008. Customers are businesses and individuals. Strong brand in insurance, and a past sponsor of Manchester United.

wiki.title: American International Group
wiki.what: American multinational finance and insurance corporation
wiki.text: American International Group, Inc. (AIG) is a global insurer headquartered in New York City, with operations in more than 200 countries and jurisdictions. Founded in 1919, the company primarily provides commercial and personal insurance products, including property and casualty insurance, liability coverage, accident and health insurance, and specialty insurance products. The company also provides risk management, multinational, and related insurance services to businesses and individuals.

about: Chubb is a Zurich-based global property and casualty insurer, listed on NYSE (CB), formed when ACE acquired Chubb Corp in 2016. It sells commercial and personal insurance, including high-net-worth home and auto cover, accident and health, reinsurance and life insurance, in about 54 countries with over $50 billion in premiums. Customers are corporations and affluent consumers. Strong brand in insurance and a past sponsor of sports events; not a mortgage firm despite the input text.

wiki.title: Chubb Limited
wiki.text: Chubb Limited is an American–Swiss company incorporated in Zürich and listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE), where it is a component of the S&P 500.

about: Zurich Insurance Group is a Swiss multinational insurer headquartered in Zurich and listed on the SIX Swiss Exchange (ZURN). It provides property and casualty, life and commercial insurance to individuals, SMEs and large corporates in more than 200 countries and territories, with about 60,000 employees and revenue over 70 billion dollars. Founded 1872. Strong global insurance brand with existing sports sponsorship, including football, cycling and the Zurich Classic of New Orleans golf event.

wiki.title: Zurich Insurance Group
wiki.text: Zurich Insurance Group Ltd. is a Swiss insurance company, headquartered in Zürich, and the country's largest insurer. As of 2024, the group is the world's 98th largest public company according to Forbes' Global 2000s list, and in 2011, it ranked 94th in Interbrand's top 100 brands.

about: Howden Group Holdings is a London-headquartered international insurance and reinsurance broking group, placing commercial, specialty, reinsurance and personal insurance for corporate and individual clients, and also running underwriting and managing general agent businesses. Founded in 2006 by David Howden, it has grown through acquisitions to operate in over 100 countries with tens of thousands of staff. Revenue is in the billions of dollars. Privately owned by management and investors including General Atlantic. B2B brand with moderate awareness in insurance and increasing corporate sponsorship visibility.

Travelers is one of the largest US property and casualty insurers, selling commercial, personal and specialty insurance for businesses, homes and cars through independent agents and brokers, with premiums of about $45 billion and a red umbrella logo. Headquartered in New York. Listed on NYSE (TRV) and a member of the Dow Jones Industrial Average. Strong brand recognition in the US with sports sponsorship, including the Travelers Championship golf tournament.

wiki.title: The Travelers Companies
wiki.text: The Travelers Companies, Inc., commonly known as Travelers, is an American multinational insurance company. It is the second-largest writer of U.S. commercial property and casualty insurance, and the sixth-largest writer of U.S. personal insurance through independent agents. Travelers is incorporated in Minnesota, with headquarters in New York City, and its largest office in Hartford, Connecticut. It has been a component of the Dow Jones Industrial Average since June 8, 2009.

about: Generali Group is one of the world's largest insurers, selling life, property and casualty insurance and asset management in about 50 countries, with premiums of about 95 billion euros. Founded in 1831 in Trieste, with business centres in Trieste and Milan. Customers are individuals and businesses. Listed on Borsa Italiana (G). Strong consumer brand in Italy and across Europe, with a winged lion logo and substantial sponsorships.

wiki.title: Assicurazioni Generali
wiki.text: Assicurazioni Generali S.p.A. or commonly known as Generali Group is an Italian insurance company based in Trieste. As of 2022, it is the largest insurance company in Italy and ranks among the world's largest insurance companies by net premiums and assets.

about: MAPFRE is a Spanish multinational insurer selling life, auto, home, health and commercial insurance in more than 40 countries, with strong positions in Spain, Brazil, Mexico and the US, and reinsurance through MAPFRE RE. Headquartered in Majadahonda, near Madrid, with revenue of about 30 billion euros. Controlled by Fundacion MAPFRE. Listed on the Madrid Stock Exchange (MAP). Strong consumer brand in Spain and Latin America, with sports and cultural sponsorship.

wiki.title: Mapfre
wiki.text: Mapfre, S.A. is a Spanish multinational insurance company, based in Majadahonda, Madrid. The name comes from the old mutual origin of the company, but the company now only refers to itself as Mapfre. It is the leading insurance company in Spain and the largest non-life insurance company in Latin America.

about: Nippon Life Insurance Company is Japan's largest private life insurer, a policyholder-owned mutual company headquartered in Osaka, selling life, annuity and health insurance, with major overseas investments including a stake in Resolution Life, which it acquired in 2025, and asset management through Nissay Asset Management. Customers are Japanese consumers and companies, with assets of well over 80 trillion yen. Not listed. Very well-known Japanese consumer insurance brand.

wiki.title: Nippon Life
wiki.text: Nippon Life Insurance Company , also known as Nissay or Nihon Seimei (日本生命) is the largest Japanese life insurance company by revenue. The company was founded in 1889 as the Nippon Life Assurance Co., Inc. In structure it is a mutual company. It first paid policyholder dividends in 1898.

about: Paris-headquartered global reinsurer, founded 1970, providing life, property and casualty and specialty reinsurance to insurers in over 100 countries, with premiums of roughly EUR 19 billion. Customers are insurance companies rather than consumers. Listed on Euronext Paris (SCR). B2B finance brand with no consumer awareness, though it has made occasional sponsorship and culture investments. It has around 3,000 employees and offices in Paris, Cologne, Singapore and Zurich, and ranks among the top five reinsurers in the world.

Tokyo-headquartered Japanese insurance group, founded 1879, selling property, life and international insurance through Tokio Marine and Nichido, and large US businesses including Philadelphia Insurance and HCC. Customers are individuals and corporates in 40+ countries. Listed in Tokyo (8766). Strong consumer brand in Japan, limited elsewhere. It has about 40,000 staff and a global footprint across North America, Europe, Asia and Latin America. Revenue is about JPY 7 trillion.

wiki.title: Tokio Marine
wiki.text: Tokio Marine Holdings, Inc., is a multinational insurance holding company headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. It is the largest property/casualty insurance group in Japan in terms of revenue and is the parent company for the Tokio Marine Group which employs 39,000 people in 38 countries worldwide.

about: Dai-ichi Life is one of Japan's largest life insurers, headquartered in Tokyo, selling life, annuity and health products to individuals and companies in Japan, with overseas holdings in the US (Protective), Australia (TAL), India, Vietnam and Europe. Founded in 1902 and demutualised in 2010, its holding company Dai-ichi Life Holdings is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange (8750). Total assets are around 60 trillion yen. Very high awareness in Japan, with sponsorship of baseball and cultural events.

wiki.title: Daiichi Life
wiki.text: Daiichi Life Group, Inc. , or Daiichi Life for short, is the third-largest life insurer in Japan by revenue, behind Japan Post Insurance and Nippon Life.

about: Intact Financial is Canada's largest property and casualty insurer, headquartered in Toronto, selling home, auto and business insurance under brands such as Intact Insurance, belairdirect, Jevco and The Guarantee, with specialty insurance in the UK and US after acquiring RSA in 2021. Listed on the TSX (IFC), it has revenue of over 20 billion Canadian dollars. Customers are Canadian households and businesses. Strong Canadian consumer brand and sports sponsor.

wiki.title: Intact Financial
wiki.text: Intact Financial Corporation (IFC) is a Canadian general insurance holding company. Currently the largest provider of property and casualty insurance in Canada, it also has insurance operations in the UK, Ireland, Europe, and United States. The company was formed in 2009, when it also went public on the Toronto Stock Exchange. It operates a number of subsidiaries and brands, such as Intact Insurance, belairdirect, BrokerLink, Intact Prestige, Intact Public Entities, On Side Restoration, Jiffy, 123.ie, and Intact Insurance Specialty Solutions. In 2024, Intact Financial had a market cap of CA$48 billion.

about: Liberty Mutual Insurance is a Boston-based global insurer, founded in 1912 and owned by policyholders as a mutual holding, offering auto, home and commercial insurance, with revenue of about $50 billion and operations in 28 countries. In the US it ranks among the top property-casualty insurers. Customers are individuals and businesses; it is known for its LiMu Emu and Doug ads and has sponsored major sports teams, college football and NASCAR, so it has strong consumer brand awareness.

wiki.title: Liberty Mutual
wiki.text: Liberty Mutual Insurance Company, often referred to as Liberty Mutual Insurance, is an American diversified global insurer and the sixth-largest property and casualty insurer in the world as of 2021. It ranks 91st on the Fortune 100 list of largest corporations in the United States based on 2025 revenue. Based in Boston, Massachusetts, it employs over 45,000 people in more than 900 locations throughout the world. As of December 31, 2021, Liberty Mutual Insurance had $156.043 billion in consolidated assets, $128.195 billion in consolidated liabilities and $48.2 billion in annual consolidated revenue.

about: Belgian-based insurance group in Brussels offering life and non-life insurance mainly in Belgium, the UK and Asia, including joint ventures in China, Thailand and Malaysia. Brands include AG Insurance and Ageas UK. Listed on Euronext Brussels (AGS). Sells to consumers and businesses; recognised in Belgium and the UK.

wiki.title: Ageas
wiki.text: Ageas is a Belgian multinational insurance company co-headquartered in Brussels. Ageas is Belgium's largest insurer and operates in 13 countries worldwide. The company was renamed from Fortis Holding in April 2010 and consists of those insurance activities remaining after the breakup and sale of the financial services group Fortis during the 2008 financial crisis.

about: QBE Insurance Group is Australia's largest international general insurer and reinsurer, headquartered in Sydney, with operations in Australia Pacific, North America and international (Lloyd's) markets, selling commercial, crop and personal insurance with revenue of about US$ 22 billion. Founded in 1886 and listed on the ASX (QBE). Recognised insurance brand in Australia, with sports sponsorships in rugby and sailing.

wiki.title: QBE Insurance
wiki.text: QBE Insurance Group Limited is an Australian multinational general insurance and reinsurance company headquartered in Sydney, Australia. QBE offers commercial, personal and specialty products and risk management products. The company employs around 13,500 people in 27 countries.

about: AIA Group is the largest Asia-Pacific-focused life insurer, founded in Shanghai in 1919 and based in Hong Kong, selling life, health, accident and retirement products to individual and corporate customers in 18 markets including Hong Kong, Singapore, Thailand, Malaysia, China and India, mainly through agents and banks. It has over 40 million customers and a market value above US$80 billion. Listed on the Hong Kong exchange (1299). Strong consumer brand in Asia, with sponsorship of sports such as the Premier League (Tottenham) and rugby.

wiki.title: AIA Group
wiki.what: Hong Kong insurance and finance company
wiki.text: AIA Group Limited is a Hong Kong multinational insurance and finance company. It is one of the largest publicly traded life insurance groups in the Asia-Pacific. AIA traces back to an American insurance firm that was established in Shanghai, China in 1919. The company then became the founding member of the American International Group (AIG) conglomerate, from which it was separated after the 2008 global financial crisis.

about: Swiss Re is a Zurich-based global reinsurance and insurance group, listed on the SIX Swiss Exchange (SREN), reinsuring life, property and casualty risks for insurers and corporates. Founded in 1863, it employs around 14,000 people, and has premiums of about $45 billion. B2B finance brand.

wiki.title: Swiss Re
wiki.text: Swiss Re Ltd is a Swiss reinsurance company founded in 1863 and headquartered in Zürich, Switzerland. It is one of the world's largest reinsurers, as measured by gross premiums written. Swiss Re operates through around 80 offices in 29 countries and employs over 14,000 people. It was ranked 519th on the Forbes Global 2000 list and ranked 316th on the Fortune Global 500 in 2023. Swiss Re is listed on the SIX Swiss Exchange.

about: Apollo (Apollo Global Management) is a New York-based alternative asset manager (NYSE: APO), founded in 1990 by Leon Black, Josh Harris and Marc Rowan, with about $750 billion in assets across credit, private equity and real assets, and owner of retirement-services insurer Athene. Investors are pensions, sovereign funds and individuals. Corporate brand known in finance; it owns consumer brands through private equity investments.

wiki.title: Apollo
wiki.text: Apollo is one of the Olympian deities in ancient Greek religion and mythology. His numerous functions include healing, prophecy, music, poetry, and archery. He is the son of Zeus and Leto, and the twin brother of Artemis, goddess of the hunt. He is considered to be the most beautiful god and is represented as the ideal of the kouros or ephebe, a beardless, athletic youth.

about: Brookfield Asset Management is one of the world's largest alternative asset managers, with over 1 trillion dollars of assets under management across renewable power, infrastructure, real estate, private equity and credit. Headquartered in Toronto and listed on the NYSE and TSX (BAM), it was separated from Brookfield Corporation in 2022. Clients are pension funds, sovereign wealth funds, insurers and private investors, and it earns management and carry fees. Portfolio companies include many well-known assets. Institutional brand with low consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Brookfield Asset Management
wiki.text: Brookfield Asset Management Ltd. is the US-based subsidiary of Canadian-based asset manager, Brookfield Corporation. The company was founded in December 2022 as a spin-off of the asset management operations of Brookfield Corporation, and manages investments across real estate, infrastructure, renewable energy, private equity, and credit markets globally. Brookfield Asset Management is run by CEO Connor Teskey, who succeeded Bruce Flatt in February 2026.

about: BlackRock is the world's largest asset manager, with about $11 trillion in assets under management, offering iShares ETFs, active funds, the Aladdin risk and portfolio platform, and private markets including GIP and Preqin acquisitions. Customers are institutions, pension funds, governments and retail investors. Headquartered in New York, founded in 1988, and listed on NYSE (BLK). Strong finance brand, known to investors; little direct consumer retail brand, though iShares is well known.

wiki.title: BlackRock
wiki.text: BlackRock, Inc. is an American multinational investment company. Founded in 1988, initially as an enterprise risk management and fixed income institutional asset manager, BlackRock is the largest asset manager worldwide, with $15.3 trillion in assets under management as of 2026. Headquartered in New York City, BlackRock has 70 offices in 30 countries and clients in 100 countries.

about: Groupama is a French mutual insurance group offering car, home, health, life and professional insurance in France and abroad, including Italy, Spain, Greece, Romania and Turkey, through agents and regional mutuals. Headquartered in Paris, with revenue of about 17 billion euros. Customers are consumers, farmers and businesses. A mutual, not listed. Well-known French consumer brand and an active sports sponsor, naming the Groupama Stadium in Lyon and the Groupama-FDJ cycling team.

wiki.title: Groupama
wiki.text: Groupama, an abbreviation for Groupe des Assurances Mutuelles Agricoles, is a French insurance group headquartered in Paris with operations in 10 countries. In 2005, it ranked as the 2nd largest mutual insurer in the world.

about: US life insurer and asset manager headquartered in Newark, New Jersey, founded 1875, selling life insurance, annuities, retirement and investment management through Prudential Financial and PGIM, with about $1.5 trillion in assets under management. Customers are individuals, employers and institutions. Listed on the NYSE (PRU). Strong consumer brand with the Rock logo, and a record of sports sponsorship such as the Prudential Center naming.

wiki.title: Prudential Financial
wiki.text: Prudential Financial, Inc. is an American financial services company whose subsidiaries provide insurance, retirement planning, investment management, and other products and services to both retail and institutional customers throughout the United States and in over 40 other countries. In 2019, Prudential was the largest insurance provider in the United States with $815.1 billion in total assets. The company is included in the Fortune Global 500 and Fortune 500 rankings.

about: Principal Financial Group is a Des Moines, Iowa financial company, listed on Nasdaq (PFG), providing retirement plans, insurance and asset management to businesses and individuals, with operations in the US, Latin America and Asia. It manages about $700 billion of assets. Customers are employers and savers. Well known in US retirement planning and a visible sponsor of sport and the arts.

wiki.title: Principal Financial Group
wiki.what: American global financial investment management and insurance company
wiki.text: Principal Financial Group, Inc. (PFG) is an American global financial investment management and insurance company headquartered in Des Moines, Iowa.

about: MetLife is one of the world's largest insurance and employee benefits providers, headquartered in New York. It sells life insurance, annuities, group benefits, dental and retirement products to individuals and corporate customers, with major operations in the US, Japan, Latin America, Europe and Asia, serving about 90 million customers in more than 40 markets. Revenue exceeds $65 billion. Founded in 1868 and listed on the NYSE (MET). Well known brand through the Snoopy mascot advertising and long-time sports sponsorships, including the former MetLife Stadium naming, so a credible F1 candidate.

wiki.title: MetLife
wiki.text: MetLife, Inc. is the holding corporation for the Metropolitan Life Insurance Company (MLIC), better known as MetLife, and its affiliates. MetLife is among the largest global providers of insurance, annuities, and employee benefit programs, with around 90 million customers in over 60 countries. The firm was founded on March 24, 1868. MetLife ranked No. 43 in the 2018 Fortune 500 list of the largest United States corporations by total revenue.

about: CK Asset Holdings is a Hong Kong property and infrastructure group, part of the CK Hutchison family led by Li Ka-shing. It develops and owns real estate in Hong Kong, mainland China, the UK and elsewhere, plus hotels, aircraft leasing and infrastructure investments. Listed in Hong Kong (1113) with a market value of tens of billions of dollars. Strongly recognised in Hong Kong, but a mainly B2B and property brand.

wiki.title: CK Asset Holdings
wiki.text: CK Asset Holdings Limited, formerly Cheung Kong Property Holdings Limited, is a property developer registered in the Cayman Islands, with its headquarters and principal place of business in Hong Kong.

about: Amundi is Europe's largest asset manager, with over two trillion euros of assets under management, offering funds, ETFs, pension and savings products to retail clients through partners, and to institutional investors. It is headquartered in Paris and was formed in 2010 from the asset management arms of Credit Agricole and Societe Generale, with Credit Agricole as majority owner. Listed on Euronext Paris (AMUN). Crunchbase shows about 225 million in funding. Well known in finance, with limited direct consumer brand awareness.

wiki.title: Amundi
wiki.text: Amundi S.A. is a French asset management company. With €2.38 trillion of assets under management (AUM) in 2025, it is one of the ten biggest investment managers in the world.

about: Swiss global private markets investment manager covering private equity, private credit, infrastructure and real estate, with roughly 150 billion dollars under management for institutional clients and wealthy individuals. Founded in 1996 and based in Baar-Zug, it is listed on the SIX Swiss Exchange (PGHN) and has offices in over 20 cities, such as Denver, Singapore and London. It earns management and performance fees. Customers are pension funds, insurers and private investors. Strong finance-sector reputation, with little mass consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Partners Group
wiki.text: Partners Group Holding AG is a Swiss-based global private equity firm with US$185 billion in assets under management in private equity, private infrastructure, private real estate, private debt and royalties.

about: Allianz is the Munich-based insurance and asset management giant, listed in Frankfurt (ALV), selling property and casualty, life and health insurance to roughly 125 million customers in more than 70 countries and managing assets through PIMCO and Allianz Global Investors. Revenues are around 160 billion euros a year. Founded in 1890. A major sports sponsor, with Olympic and Paralympic partnerships and stadium naming rights such as Allianz Arena in Munich, so brand visibility is very high.

wiki.title: Allianz
wiki.text: Allianz SE is a German multinational financial services company headquartered in Munich, Germany. Its core businesses are insurance and asset management.

about: Retail investing platform offering commission-free trading of stocks, ETFs, options, cryptocurrency, retirement accounts and a premium subscription (Robinhood Gold), plus a credit card and event contracts. Customers are mostly younger US retail investors, with over 25 million funded accounts. Revenue comes from payment for order flow, interest income, subscriptions and crypto trading. Headquartered in Menlo Park, California; founded 2013. Listed on Nasdaq (HOOD) since 2021 and added to the S&P 500 in 2025. Strong consumer fintech brand with high awareness among US retail investors.

wiki.title: Robinhood (company)
wiki.text: Robinhood Markets, Inc. is an American financial services company based in Menlo Park, California. It provides an electronic trading platform that facilitates trades of stocks, exchange-traded funds (ETFs), options, index options, futures contracts, event contracts on prediction markets, and cryptocurrency. It also offers cryptocurrency wallets, wealth management, credit cards and other banking services, some in partnership with banks insured by the FDIC, and operates a venture capital arm as well as an independent media subsidiary, Sherwood.News.

about: Payments processor providing integrated payment processing and software to restaurants, hotels, stadiums, retailers and online businesses, including POS systems and acquired brands such as Finaro and Global Blue. Earns from processing fees and software subscriptions, handling hundreds of billions in payment volume. Headquartered in Center Valley, Pennsylvania (formerly Allentown); founded 1999 by Jared Isaacman. Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (FOUR). B2B payments brand with small consumer profile, but active in sports venue partnerships and it sponsored motorsport events.

wiki.title: Shift4
wiki.text: Shift4 Payments, Inc. is an American payment processing company based in Allentown, Pennsylvania. The company, founded in 1999 by the then 16-year-old Jared Isaacman, processes payments for over 200,000 businesses in the retail, hospitality, leisure, and restaurant industries. Shift4 specializes in commerce technology such as mobile payment software and hardware. The company was publicly listed on the New York Stock Exchange in 2020.

about: Payments company operating the Epay prepaid top-up, Ria money transfer and Euronet ATM and card processing businesses, plus the Dandelion network, moving money and digital value across 200 countries. Customers are consumers sending remittances, banks, mobile operators and retailers, with revenue near 4 billion dollars. Headquartered in Leawood, Kansas; founded 1994. Listed on Nasdaq (EEFT). Ria is a recognised remittance brand in migrant communities, with some sports sponsorship.

wiki.title: Euronet Worldwide
wiki.text: Euronet is an American provider of global electronic payment services with headquarters in Leawood, Kansas. It offers automated teller machines (ATM), point of sale (POS) services, credit/debit card services, currency exchange and other electronic financial services and payments software. Among others, it provides the prepaid subsidiaries Transact, PaySpot, epay, Movilcarga, TeleRecarga and ATX.

about: State Street is a major US custody bank and asset manager, providing asset servicing, investment management through State Street Investment Management (SPDR ETFs) and alpha platform services. Customers are institutional investors, with around 50 trillion dollars under custody and administration and revenue near 22 billion dollars. Headquartered in Boston; founded 1792. Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (STT). Institutional brand known to finance professionals, with the SPDR ETF brand better known to retail investors; has sponsored events.

Manulife Financial is Canada's largest life insurer, offering life and health insurance, wealth and asset management and retirement products to individuals and institutions in Canada, the US (John Hancock) and Asia, with assets under management above 1 trillion Canadian dollars. Headquartered in Toronto; founded 1887. Listed on the Toronto and New York exchanges (MFC). Well-known consumer financial brand and active sponsor of sports and events.

wiki.title: Manulife
wiki.what: Canadian multinational insurance and financial services company
wiki.text: Manulife Financial Corporation is a Canadian multinational insurance company and financial services provider headquartered in Toronto, Ontario. The company operates in Canada and Asia as "Manulife" and in the United States primarily through its John Hancock Financial division. As of December 2021, the company employed approximately 38,000 people and had 119,000 agents under contract, and has CA$1.4 trillion in assets under management and administration. Manulife at one point serviced over 26 million customers worldwide.

about: Mitsubishi Corporation is Japan's largest general trading company, with businesses in natural gas, industrial materials, chemicals, mobility, food and consumer products (including the Lawson convenience store chain), power, and in metals. Revenue near 17 trillion yen. Headquartered in Tokyo; founded 1950 after the post-war breakup of the Mitsubishi zaibatsu. Listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange (8058), with Berkshire Hathaway as a notable holder. Large B2B conglomerate with strong Japanese brand recognition.

wiki.title: Mitsubishi Corporation
wiki.text: Mitsubishi Corporation is a Japanese general trading company and a core member of the Mitsubishi Group. For much of the post-war period, Mitsubishi Corporation has been the largest of the five great sogo shosha by revenue as well as profits.

about: Sumitomo Corporation is a Japanese general trading company with businesses in metals, transport and construction systems, infrastructure, media and digital, lifestyle retail (Summit supermarkets) and mineral resources. Revenue near 6 trillion yen. Headquartered in Tokyo; founded 1919. Listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange (8053), part of the Sumitomo keiretsu. B2B conglomerate with strong Japanese recognition and limited consumer sponsorship.

wiki.title: Sumitomo Corporation
wiki.text: Sumitomo Corporation is one of the largest worldwide sōgō shōsha general trading companies, and is a diversified corporation. The company was incorporated in 1919 and is a member company of the Sumitomo Group.

wiki.title: Sumitomo Group
wiki.text: The Sumitomo Group is a group of autonomous Japanese multinational companies.

about: Remitly is a digital remittance company allowing migrants to send money from the US, Canada, UK, EU, Australia and other countries to over 170 receiving countries through a mobile app, with fast transfers and transparent fees. Revenue near 1.6 billion dollars. Headquartered in Seattle, Washington; founded 2011. Listed on Nasdaq (RELY) since 2021. Strong consumer brand in migrant communities and active in sports sponsorship.

wiki.title: Remitly
wiki.text: Remitly is an American online remittance service based in Seattle, United States that offers international money transfers to over 170 countries. It was founded in 2011 by Matthew Oppenheimer, Josh Hug, and Shivaas Gulati and became publicly traded on the Nasdaq exchange in September 2021.

about: Zepz (formerly Sendwave and WorldRemit, merged 2021) is a London-based digital money-transfer company. Its apps, WorldRemit and Sendwave, let migrants send money from countries such as the UK, US, Canada and Europe to mobile wallets, bank accounts and cash pickup in Africa, Asia and Latin America. It earns fees and foreign-exchange margin on transfers, serving millions of retail customers across roughly 130 countries. Privately held and venture-backed, with over $1bn raised. Consumer fintech brand with solid awareness within diaspora communities, little mainstream profile.

Acrisure is a Grand Rapids, Michigan financial services firm that began as an insurance broker and has grown through hundreds of acquisitions. It offers insurance brokerage, reinsurance, employee benefits, asset and wealth management, cyber services, real estate services and AI-driven insurance technology to businesses and individuals worldwide. It reports revenue of several billion dollars and tens of thousands of staff in over 100 countries. Privately held, backed by investors including Blackstone, Bain and Mubadala. Acrisure holds naming rights to Acrisure Stadium, the Pittsburgh Steelers' home, and is active in sports sponsorship.

wiki.title: Acrisure
wiki.text: Acrisure is an American financial technology and insurance company headquartered in Grand Rapids, Michigan. The company was initially created to acquire insurance companies in the Midwestern United States and has since expanded nationally. In 2022, Business Insurance recognized Acrisure as the 6th largest insurance broker in the world.

about: Affirm is a San Francisco fintech offering buy-now-pay-later loans at online and in-store checkouts. It partners with merchants such as Amazon, Shopify, Walmart and Apple, and earns merchant fees, interest on loans and interchange from its debit card. Customers are US, Canadian and UK shoppers, and the company reports annual gross merchandise volume above $30bn. Founded in 2012 by Max Levchin, it listed on the Nasdaq (AFRM) in 2021. Consumer-facing brand with strong US awareness through checkout buttons; it has run sports sponsorships including the NFL and Premier League deals.

wiki.title: Affirm Holdings
wiki.text: Affirm Holdings, Inc. is an American financial technology company and a point-of-sale lender. Founded in 2012 by PayPal co-founder Max Levchin, it is the largest U.S. based buy now, pay later (BNPL) financier. As of 2026, Affirm reports nearly 28 million users and processes $50 billion in annual payments.

about: Nexi is a Milan-based European payments company (PayTech), formed by the merger of Nexi, Nets and SIA. It provides merchant acquiring, card issuing and processing, digital banking infrastructure and online payment services to banks, merchants and businesses across Italy, the Nordics, the DACH region and Central and Eastern Europe. It serves millions of merchants and has annual revenue around EUR3.5bn. Listed on Borsa Italiana (NEXI) with investors including Hellman and Friedman and Bain Capital. Mostly B2B, though the logo is visible at payment terminals and through sponsorships.

wiki.title: Nexi
wiki.text: Nexi S.p.A., formerly known as Istituto Centrale delle Banche Popolari Italiane S.p.A. (ICBPI), is an Italian company that offers digital payment services and infrastructure for banks, companies, institutions, and public administrations.

about: PhonePe is a Bengaluru-based Indian digital payments and financial services platform built on the UPI system, with a leading market share of UPI transactions. Its app serves several hundred million registered users and millions of merchants, offering payments, wealth products, insurance distribution, lending referrals and merchant devices. Majority-owned by Walmart after Flipkart's 2016 acquisition and separated from Flipkart in 2022. Private, and preparing a stock market listing in India. Strong consumer brand in India with big cricket, IPL and media sponsorships.

wiki.title: PhonePe
wiki.text: PhonePe is an Indian digital payments and financial services company, headquartered in Bengaluru. It was founded in December 2015, by Sameer Nigam, Rahul Chari and Burzin Engineer. The PhonePe app, based on the Unified Payments Interface, went live in August 2016.

about: Binance is the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume, founded in 2017 by Changpeng Zhao, with a legal presence rooted in the Cayman Islands and operations spread globally. It offers spot and derivatives trading, staking, a launchpad, payments, wallets and the BNB Chain ecosystem to well over 250 million registered users. In 2023 it pleaded guilty to US anti-money-laundering charges and paid $4.3bn. Private. Highly known crypto brand; it has used sports sponsorships (such as with Argentina's football team) but faces regulatory sensitivity in many jurisdictions.

wiki.title: Binance
wiki.text: Binance Holdings Ltd., branded Binance, is the largest cryptocurrency exchange in terms of daily trading volume of cryptocurrencies. Binance was founded in 2017 by Changpeng Zhao. It was initially based in China, then moved to Japan, subsequently left Japan for Malta, and now has no official company headquarters.

about: Checkout.com is a London-based global payments company, founded in 2012, which provides card acquiring, payment processing, fraud tools and payouts to merchants like Netflix, eBay, Shein, Sony and Samsung. It handles over $300bn in processed volume and was valued at $40bn in 2022, then marked down to $12bn in 2025. Private. B2B fintech, well known in e-commerce and payments, with its brand showing in sports sponsorship, such as Formula 1 and the Premier League.

wiki.title: Checkout.com
wiki.text: Checkout.com is a financial technology company headquartered in London, United Kingdom. It provides payment processing services, operating as a payment gateway, acquirer, and processor for enterprise clients in sectors such as e-commerce, technology, and media. In 2022, It had a valuation of $40 billion making it the most valuable European fintech startup. Its clients include Netflix, eBay, Klarna, DocuSign, Uber Eats, Pinterest, Vinted, and ASOS.

about: Majid Al Futtaim is a Dubai-based Emirati conglomerate, founded in 1992 by Majid Al Futtaim, that owns and operates the Mall of the Emirates, City Centre malls, Carrefour franchise stores in the Middle East, Africa and Asia, VOX Cinemas, Ski Dubai and Magic Planet, plus retail brands and a consumer finance unit. It employs over 40,000 people, with revenue of roughly $10bn. Privately held by the Majid Al Futtaim family. Very high consumer visibility in the Gulf.

wiki.title: Majid Al Futtaim
wiki.text: Majid Al Futtaim was an Emirati billionaire businessman, and the founder and owner of the Majid Al Futtaim Group, an Emirati real estate and retail conglomerate, with projects in Asia and Africa.

about: MSCI is a New York provider of investment indexes, analytics, ESG ratings and risk models, including the MSCI World and Emerging Markets indexes, used by asset managers, banks and pension funds worldwide. It earns subscriptions and asset-based fees from index-linked products, with revenue near $3bn. Listed on the NYSE (MSCI). B2B financial data company with strong finance-industry recognition and no general consumer awareness.

wiki.title: MSCI
wiki.text: MSCI Inc. is an American finance company headquartered in New York City. MSCI is a global provider of equity, fixed income, real estate indices, multi-asset portfolio analysis tools, ESG and climate finance products. It operates the MSCI World, MSCI Emerging Markets, and MSCI All Country World (ACWI) indices, among others.

about: Genting Berhad is a Kuala Lumpur-based Malaysian conglomerate under Lim Kok Thay, with leisure and hospitality (Resorts World Genting casino and theme park, Resorts World Las Vegas, Resorts World Sentosa in Singapore, Genting Malaysia), plantations, power generation and oil and gas operations. It earns revenue from gaming, hotels and cruise lines such as Resorts World Cruises. Listed on Bursa Malaysia (GENTING). Strong consumer visibility in Southeast Asia, including with gaming and entertainment brands.

wiki.title: Genting Group
wiki.text: The Genting Group is headquartered in Wisma Genting in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. The Group comprises the holding company Genting Berhad, its listed subsidiaries Genting Malaysia Berhad, Genting Plantations Berhad, Genting Singapore PLC, as well as its wholly-owned subsidiary Genting Energy Limited.

about: Ameriprise Financial is a Minneapolis-based financial services company, spun out of American Express in 2005. It offers financial planning, wealth management, retirement, insurance and asset management (Columbia Threadneedle Investments) through about 10,000 advisors. Assets under management and administration exceed $1.5 trillion, with an NYSE listing (AMP). Customers are affluent retail and institutional investors in the US and abroad. Strong brand recognition in the US, with sponsorship of golf and Ameriprise Invitational events.

wiki.title: Ameriprise Financial
wiki.text: Ameriprise Financial, Inc. is an American diversified financial services company and bank holding company based in Minneapolis, Minnesota. It provides financial planning products and services, including wealth management, asset management, insurance, annuities, and estate planning.

about: Ant International is the Singapore-based international arm of Ant Group, created in 2023, providing digital payments, wallet and fintech services such as Alipay+, Antom, WorldFirst and Bettr. It connects merchants and users across over 100 markets, processing payments for global brands and tourism flows. Owned by Ant Group, an affiliate of Alibaba founder Jack Ma. B2B brand mostly, with the Alipay+ consumer network visible to tourists, and has sponsored sports events.

wiki.title: Ant Group
wiki.text: Ant Group, formerly known as Ant Financial, is an affiliate company of the Chinese conglomerate Alibaba Group. Ant Group was initially the financial transaction arm of Alibaba, Alipay, when it was set up in 2004.

about: Great-West Lifeco is a Winnipeg-based Canadian financial services holding company that owns Canada Life, Empower (US retirement services) and Irish Life, offering life and health insurance, retirement plans, wealth management and reinsurance to millions of customers in Canada, the US and Europe. Controlled by Power Corporation of Canada and listed on the TSX (GWO). Assets under administration exceed a trillion dollars. Brand known in Canada and Europe through Canada Life and Empower, which have sponsored sports.

wiki.title: Great-West Lifeco
wiki.text: Great-West Lifeco Inc. is a Canadian insurance-centered financial holding company that operates in North America, Europe and Asia through five wholly owned, regionally focused subsidiaries. Many of the companies it has indirect control over are part of its largest subsidiary, The Canada Life Assurance Company; the others are managed by Great-West Lifeco U.S. LLC, a U.S. based subsidiary. Great-West Lifeco is indirectly controlled by Montreal billionaire Paul Desmarais Jr. through his stake in the Power Corporation of Canada, which owns 72% of Great-West Lifeco. The hyphen in the company's name was originally a typesetter's error.

about: Swiss Life Group is a Zurich-based provider of life insurance, pensions and financial planning, with operations in Switzerland, France, Germany and international markets, and a real estate asset manager (Swiss Life Asset Managers) and independent advisers (AWD and Tecis). Founded 1857 and listed on the SIX Swiss Exchange (SLHN). Customers are individuals and companies. Well-known insurance brand in Switzerland and France, with sports sponsorship.

Finastra is a London-headquartered financial software company supplying core banking, lending, payments and treasury platforms to banks and financial institutions in more than 100 countries, with about 7,000 employees. Created in 2017 when Misys acquired D+H, it is owned by private equity firm Vista Equity Partners, which sold the Treasury and Capital Markets unit to Apax in 2025. Revenue is software licences, subscriptions and services. B2B with low consumer awareness but strong banking industry presence.

wiki.title: Finastra
wiki.text: Finastra is a global financial services software company headquartered in London. Its US hub is found in Atlanta, Georgia. It provides software for Lending and Corporate Banking, Payments, and Retail and Digital Banking.

about: Silver Lake is a large technology-focused private equity firm founded in 1999, headquartered in Menlo Park, California with offices in New York, London, Hong Kong and elsewhere. It manages over 100 billion dollars across buyouts and growth investments in Dell, Endeavor, Qualtrics and other companies, and raises money from pension funds and endowments, earning management and carry fees. Co-owner of Manchester City's City Football Group stake and owner of a stake in Endeavor, so it has existing sports exposure. Institutional brand.

Arch Capital Group is a Bermuda-based specialty insurance, reinsurance and mortgage insurance company listed on Nasdaq (ACGL). It writes property, casualty, specialty and mortgage insurance and reinsurance through Lloyd's syndicates and offices in the US, UK, Europe and Canada, serving businesses and other insurers. Revenue is premiums, with more than 15 billion dollars of annual net premiums written. Founded 2001 as Arch from Risk Capital Holdings. B2B insurer with low consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Arch Capital Group
wiki.text: Arch Capital Group Ltd. is a Bermuda exempted public company which writes insurance, reinsurance and mortgage insurance on a worldwide basis, with a focus on specialty lines, the segment of the insurance industry where the more difficult and unusual risks are written. The company is headquartered in Bermuda and operates globally in 60 offices in North America, Europe, Asia and Australia.

about: Corpay (formerly FLEETCOR Technologies) is a US corporate payments company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia and listed on the NYSE (CPAY). It provides fleet fuel cards, cross-border and B2B payments, and lodging cards to businesses in 90 countries, with about 10,000 employees and revenue around 4 billion dollars. It earns from interchange, fees and FX. Rebranded Corpay in 2023. B2B brand with low consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Corpay
wiki.text: Corpay, Inc., headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, provides payments and spend management systems and services that control expense-related purchasing and payment processes. The company focuses on vehicle-related expenses, lodging expenses, and corporate payments.

about: EXOR is a Dutch-registered holding company of the Agnelli family, headquartered in Amsterdam and listed on Euronext Amsterdam, with the family company Giovanni Agnelli BV as controller. It owns stakes in Ferrari, Stellantis, CNH Industrial, Juventus FC, The Economist Group, Philips, Institut Merieux and others, with a portfolio worth roughly 40 billion euros. It earns from dividends and investment gains. Founded as IFI in 1927. Holds stakes in Ferrari and Juventus, so strong sports links; the holding itself is a B2B investor.

Itau Unibanco is the largest private bank in Brazil and Latin America by market value, headquartered in Sao Paulo and listed on the B3 and NYSE (ITUB). It serves tens of millions of retail, corporate and private banking customers with cards, insurance, asset management and investment banking, operating also in Argentina, Chile, Colombia, Paraguay and Uruguay. Formed in 2008 by the merger of Banco Itau and Unibanco. Extremely strong Brazilian consumer brand with many sponsorships, including football.

wiki.title: Itaú Unibanco
wiki.text: Banco Itaú Unibanco S.A. is a Brazilian financial services company headquartered in São Paulo, Brazil. Itaú Unibanco was formed through the merger of Banco Itaú and Unibanco in 2008. It is the largest banking institution in Brazil, as well as the largest in Latin America, and the seventy-third largest bank in the world. The bank is listed on the B3 in São Paulo and in NYSE in New York.

about: CIMB Group is a Malaysian universal bank headquartered in Kuala Lumpur and listed on Bursa Malaysia (CIMB), the country's second-largest banking group by assets. It offers consumer, commercial, investment and Islamic banking, with major operations in Malaysia, Indonesia (CIMB Niaga), Singapore and Thailand and about 33,000 employees. Strong ASEAN consumer brand with extensive sports and event sponsorship.

wiki.title: CIMB
wiki.text: CIMB Group Holdings Berhad is a Malaysian universal bank headquartered in Kuala Lumpur and operating in high growth economies in ASEAN. CIMB Group is an indigenous ASEAN investment bank. CIMB has a wide retail branch network with 1,080 branches across the region.

about: NCR Corporation, now operating as NCR Voyix after the 2023 spin-off of ATM business NCR Atleos, is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia and listed on the NYSE (VYX). It sells point-of-sale, self-checkout, payments and restaurant and retail software to merchants, with customers including restaurants and grocery chains. Founded in 1884 as National Cash Register. Revenue is about 2.8 billion dollars. B2B brand with moderate recognition in retail technology.

wiki.title: NCR Voyix
wiki.text: NCR Voyix Corporation, previously known as NCR Corporation and National Cash Register, is a global software, consulting and technology company providing several professional services and electronic products. It produces self-service kiosks, point-of-sale software and terminals, check processing systems, thermal printers, and barcode scanners.

about: Nuvei is a Montreal-based global payments technology company offering payment processing, acquiring, local payment methods, risk tools and card issuing for merchants in e-commerce, iGaming, travel and retail, in over 200 markets. Founded in 2003 by Philip Fayer. It went public on Nasdaq and TSX (NVEI) in 2021 and was taken private by Advent International in 2024 in a deal valued around $6.3 billion. Revenue was about $1.2 billion. B2B payments brand, notable in gaming and sports betting, with little consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Nuvei
wiki.text: Nuvei Corporation, formerly known as Pivotal Payments, is a Canadian payment processor headquartered in Montreal, Quebec. The company provides payment-processing and acquiring services for online and in-person transactions. Nuvei went public on the Toronto Stock Exchange in 2020 and later listed on Nasdaq in 2021.

about: Ledger is a Paris-based maker of hardware wallets such as the Ledger Nano and Stax devices for storing cryptocurrency, plus the Ledger Live app and enterprise custody tools, having sold over 6 million devices. Founded in 2014. Customers are individual crypto holders and institutions. Has raised about $577 million in total funding and was valued over $1 billion. Private. Well-known crypto consumer brand, subject of a 2020 customer data leak.

wiki.title: Ledger
wiki.text: A ledger is a book or collection of accounts in which accounting transactions are recorded. Each account has:an opening or brought-forward balance; a list of transactions, each recorded as either a debit or credit in separate columns and an ending or closing, or carry-forward, balance.

about: CMC Markets is a London-based online trading company offering contracts for difference, spread betting and forex through its Next Generation platform, plus stockbroking, and providing white-label technology to banks and brokers. Customers are retail and institutional traders in the UK, Europe, Australia and Asia. Founded in 1989. Listed on the London Stock Exchange (CMCX). Known among traders, and a past sponsor of sports and events.

wiki.title: CMC Markets
wiki.text: CMC Markets plc is a UK-based financial services company that offers online trading in shares, spread betting, contracts for difference (CFDs), and foreign exchange across global markets. The company is headquartered in London, with hubs in Sydney and Singapore. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is a constituent of the FTSE 250 Index.

about: Thunes is a Singapore-based cross-border payments network connecting banks, mobile money wallets and payment providers across more than 130 countries, letting customers send money to wallets, accounts and cards in real time. Customers are fintechs, remittance firms and global platforms, with revenue from transaction fees. Founded in 2016. Crunchbase shows about $352 million in funding. Private. B2B infrastructure brand, no consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Thunes
wiki.text: Thunes is a Singapore-based financial technology company that provides cross-border payment infrastructure for financial institutions, businesses, and payment providers. Its network enables transactions to digital wallets, bank accounts, stablecoin wallets and cash outlets. Thunes is also collaborating with Circle to enable cross-border settlements using the stablecoin USDC. Thunes is regulated as a ''Major Payment Institution'' by the Monetary Authority of Singapore.

about: Phantom is a crypto wallet, best known for Solana, now also supporting Ethereum, Bitcoin, Base and Polygon, letting users buy, swap, stake and hold tokens and NFTs through a browser extension and mobile app. Founded in 2021 and based in San Francisco. Revenue comes from swap fees and other services. Has raised about $268 million and was valued around $3 billion in 2025. Private. Large user base with strong awareness in the crypto community.

Toronto-based Canadian life insurer and wealth manager, founded 1865, selling insurance, retirement and asset management to individuals, employers and institutions in Canada, the US, Asia and the UK, with about $1.4 trillion in assets. Listed on the TSX and NYSE (SLF). Well-known consumer brand in Canada and sponsor of sports and cultural events. Sun Life has about 55,000 employees and operates in Canada, the US, Asia and the UK, with assets of about C$1.5 trillion.

wiki.title: Sun Life Financial
wiki.text: Sun Life Financial Inc. is a financial services company headquartered in Toronto, Canada. Founded in 1865, it operates internationally in life insurance, wealth management, and asset management. As of 2024, the company manages over CAD$1.3 trillion in assets and serves clients in Canada, the United States, Asia, and other markets.

about: Futu Holdings is a Hong Kong-headquartered online brokerage and wealth management company listed on Nasdaq (FUTU). It runs the Futu NiuNiu app for investors in Hong Kong and mainland China, and Moomoo for customers in the US, Singapore, Australia, Canada and Japan. It earns trading commissions, margin interest and wealth management fees from several million paying clients. Strong retail investor brand in Hong Kong, with growing international marketing.

wiki.title: Futu
wiki.text: Futu Holdings Limited is a Cayman Islands-incorporated financial technology holding company headquartered in Hong Kong. Through its subsidiaries, it provides online securities brokerage, margin financing and securities lending, wealth management, and corporate and institutional services. Its main digital platforms are Futubull, used primarily in Hong Kong, and Moomoo, its international platform. Its ADR have traded on the Nasdaq since March 2019.

about: Xero is a New Zealand cloud accounting software company, founded in 2006 and headquartered in Wellington, with a primary listing on the Australian Securities Exchange (XRO). It sells subscription accounting, payroll and payments software to small businesses and their accountants, with over 4 million subscribers in Australia, New Zealand, the UK, US and elsewhere. It bought Melio in 2025. Strong brand among small businesses and accountants, and it has sponsored sport.

wiki.title: Xero
wiki.text: Xero Limited is a New Zealand technology company that provides cloud-based accounting software for small businesses. The company has offices in New Zealand, Australia, the United Kingdom, the United States, Canada, South Africa and Singapore. Xero's products are based on the software-as-a-service model and sold by subscription, based on the type and number of entities managed by the subscriber. The products are used in over 180 countries.

about: bolttech is a Singapore-headquartered insurtech, founded in 2020, whose platform lets telecom firms, retailers, banks and device makers embed device protection, travel and other insurance at the point of sale. It operates in more than 30 markets across Asia, Europe and the US, backed by Mundi Ventures, Tokio Marine and others, with recorded funding of about $690 million. B2B2C, with limited direct consumer brand awareness.

London-based money transfer fintech, founded 2017, letting consumers send money to cards across 160 countries via app. Revenue from transfer fees; customers are migrants and families. Moderate consumer awareness, advertised online and in sports sponsorships.

XTB is a Warsaw-based online broker offering forex and CFD trading, as well as stocks and ETFs, through its xStation platform to retail clients in Poland, Spain, Germany, the UK and elsewhere. Founded in 2002 and listed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange (XTB), it earns from spreads and commissions and reports clients in the hundreds of thousands. Retail brand known in trading circles in Europe with football sponsorship history.

IG Group is a London based online trading and investing company, offering spread betting, CFDs, share dealing and forex under brands such as IG, tastytrade, Independent Reserve and Spectrum, with more than 300,000 active clients. It earns trading and commission revenue and is listed on the London Stock Exchange (IGG) in the FTSE 250. Founded in 1974, it has been a large sponsor in UK sport and was a partner of Formula 1 teams. It is a well recognised retail trading brand.

wiki.title: IG Group
wiki.text: IG Group Holdings plc, trading as IG Group, is a United Kingdom-based online trading and investment provider, offering access to spread betting, US futures and options, stock and crypto trading, which allows traders to bet on the direction of equities, bonds and currencies without owning the underlying assets.

about: Nium is a payment infrastructure company, founded in Singapore and with a San Francisco base listed here, that provides cross-border payments, card issuing and wallets via a single API to banks, fintechs and enterprises in over 100 countries. Founded in 2014 (as Instarem), it reached a unicorn valuation of about 2 billion dollars in 2021. Total funding is around $338 million. It is a B2B fintech with limited consumer brand awareness.

wiki.title: Nium
wiki.text: Nium is a Singapore-headquartered cross-border payments company. Initially founded by Prajit Nanu and Michael Bermingham, and launched as a consumer-remittance platform Instarem in 2014. In 2016, the company introduced its B2B payments platform and rebranded as Nium in 2019, subsequently elevating Pratik Gandhi to co-founder in 2021. However, Gandhi left Nium in October 2023, around the time Nium's Chief Product Officer also left the company and Nium announced a layoff of over 10% of its global staff.

about: Online trading firm headquartered in Tel Aviv (listed on London's main market under PLUS), offering contracts for difference on shares, indices, FX and crypto to retail traders. Known as a sports sponsor, including Atletico Madrid and Seattle Sounders shirt deals. Strong brand among traders, with large sports sponsorship portfolio.

wiki.title: Plus500
wiki.text: Plus500 is a global multi-asset financial technology company headquartered in Haifa, Israel, that provides online trading services in contracts for difference (CFDs), share dealing, futures trading, prediction markets and options on futures. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is a constituent of the FTSE 250 Index and the STOXX Europe 600.

about: Adyen is a Dutch payments company headquartered in Amsterdam that provides a single platform for online, in-store and mobile payments, acquiring, risk management and issuing for merchants such as Uber, Spotify, eBay and Microsoft. It earns a small fee on each transaction processed and handles hundreds of billions of euros in volume a year. Founded in 2006, it listed on Euronext Amsterdam (ADYEN) in 2018. Crunchbase shows $266 million raised pre-IPO. B2B brand with notable visibility in finance and motorsport circles, as a sponsor in sport.

wiki.title: Adyen
wiki.text: Adyen is a Dutch payment company with the status of an acquiring bank that allows businesses to accept e-commerce, mobile, and point-of-sale payments. It is listed on the stock exchange Euronext Amsterdam.

about: Indian Oil Corporation is India's flagship state-owned oil company, based in New Delhi, with refining (about 80 million tonnes a year), pipelines, marketing and the largest retail fuel network in India with over 38,000 fuel stations under IndianOil, XtraPremium and Servo lubricants. Revenue is more than 8 trillion rupees. Majority owned by the government of India, listed on NSE and BSE (IOC). Very high consumer awareness in India and a big sponsor in cricket and motorsport.

wiki.title: Indian Oil Corporation
wiki.what: Indian multinational oil and gas company
wiki.text: Indian Oil Corporation Limited (IOCL), is an Indian multinational oil and gas company under the ownership of the Government of India and administrative control of the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas. It is a public sector undertaking which is registered in Mumbai and headquartered in New Delhi. It is the largest government-owned oil producer in the country both in terms of capacity and revenue. It has consolidated refining capacity of 80.55MMTPA.

about: Reliance Industries is a Mumbai-based Indian conglomerate, controlled by Mukesh Ambani, with businesses in oil refining and petrochemicals, retail (Reliance Retail), digital services and telecom (Jio Platforms, with over 480 million subscribers), and media and new energy. Revenue is about $100 billion with a listing on the NSE and BSE (RELIANCE). Customers are hundreds of millions of Indian consumers. Very high brand awareness in India, owner of the Mumbai Indians cricket team and a major sports sponsor.

wiki.title: Reliance Industries
wiki.text: Reliance Industries Limited is an Indian multinational conglomerate headquartered in Mumbai. Its businesses include energy, petrochemicals, natural gas, retail, entertainment, telecommunications, mass media, and textiles. Reliance is the largest public company in India by market capitalisation and revenue, and the 88th largest company worldwide. It is India's largest private tax payer and largest exporter, accounting for 7% of India's total merchandise exports.

about: Cheniere Energy is the largest US producer of liquefied natural gas, headquartered in Houston and listed on the NYSE American (LNG). It operates the Sabine Pass terminal in Louisiana and the Corpus Christi terminal in Texas, exporting LNG to buyers across Europe, Asia and Latin America under long-term contracts. Revenue is tolling and sales to utilities, trading houses and energy majors, around 20 billion dollars annually. Founded 1996. B2B energy infrastructure with little consumer visibility.

wiki.title: Cheniere Energy
wiki.text: Cheniere Energy, Inc. is an American liquefied natural gas (LNG) company headquartered in Houston, Texas.

about: Naturgy is a Spanish integrated gas and electricity utility headquartered in Madrid, listed on the Spanish stock exchange (NTGY). It supplies natural gas and electricity to around 15 million customers in Spain, Latin America and elsewhere, operates networks and renewable power generation and has a large global LNG business. Revenue is roughly 22 billion euros. Formerly Gas Natural Fenosa, renamed 2018. Major shareholders include CVC, GIP and Criteria Caixa. Established consumer energy brand in Spain with football and sports sponsorships.

wiki.title: Naturgy
wiki.text: Naturgy Energy Group S.A., formerly Gas Natural Fenosa, is a Spanish multinational natural gas and electrical energy utilities company, which operates primarily in Spain. The company's administrative headquarters are in Madrid.

about: QatarEnergy, formerly Qatar Petroleum, is the state-owned oil and gas company of Qatar, headquartered in Doha, and one of the world's largest LNG producers with capacity of 77 million tonnes a year, being expanded to about 142 million. It also operates upstream fields, petrochemicals, fertilisers and shipping, and holds international stakes in projects such as Golden Pass LNG. Founded 1974; wholly owned by the Government of Qatar. B2B energy giant, a long-time sponsor of sport and events in the Gulf.

wiki.title: QatarEnergy
wiki.text: QatarEnergy is the state-owned national petroleum and natural gas company of Qatar. The company operates all oil and gas related activities in Qatar, including exploration, production, refining, transport, and storage. The President and CEO is Saad Sherida al-Kaabi, who is also the minister of state for energy affairs.

about: Vedanta is a diversified Indian natural resources group in the Anil Agarwal family, with Vedanta Resources in London and operating Vedanta Limited listed in India, headquartered in Mumbai. It produces zinc, lead, silver, aluminium, copper, iron ore, oil and gas and steel in India, Africa and Namibia, with revenue of roughly 17 billion dollars. Its subsidiary Hindustan Zinc is the world's largest integrated zinc producer. Founded 1976. Mainly B2B; Cairn and Hindustan Zinc and others sponsor sport. A 2025 demerger split the group into several listed units.

wiki.title: Vedanta
wiki.what: One of the six orthodox traditions of Hindu philosophy
wiki.text: Vedanta, also known as Uttara Mīmāṃsā, is one of the six orthodox (āstika) schools of Hindu philosophy and textual exegesis. The word Vedanta means 'conclusion of the Vedas,' and encompasses the ideas that emerged from, or aligned and reinterpreted, the speculations and enumerations contained in the Upanishads, focusing, with varying emphasis, on devotion, knowledge, and liberation. Vedanta developed into many traditions, all of which give their specific interpretations of a common group of texts called the Prasthānatrayī, translated as 'the three sources': the Upanishads, the Brahma Sutras, and the Bhagavad Gita.

about: ADNOC, the Abu Dhabi National Oil Company, is the state-owned energy group of Abu Dhabi, covering onshore and offshore oil and gas exploration and production, refining, petrochemicals via Borouge, gas processing, and fuel retail through ADNOC Distribution. It produces around 4 million barrels of oil per day and has subsidiaries including ADNOC Drilling, ADNOC Gas and XRG. Wholly owned by the Abu Dhabi government. Several subsidiaries are listed on ADX. Very high brand profile in the Gulf.

wiki.title: Abu Dhabi National Oil Company
wiki.text: The Abu Dhabi National Oil Company, known by its acronym ADNOC, is the state-owned oil company of Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates. It is the world's 12th largest oil company by production. In 2024, ADNOC had a crude oil production capacity of 4.85 million barrels per day and planned to increase it to 5 million barrels per day by 2027. It is the United Arab Emirate's largest oil company.

about: Petrobras is Brazil's state-controlled oil and gas company, producing about 2.7 million barrels of oil equivalent per day, largely from deep-water pre-salt fields, with refining, fuel distribution, gas and growing renewables. Headquartered in Rio de Janeiro. The Brazilian federal government holds the voting control. Listed on B3 (PETR3/PETR4) and NYSE (PBR). Revenue is around $90 billion. Very high brand profile in Brazil, with a long history of sponsoring Brazilian sport and motorsport.

wiki.title: Petrobras
wiki.what: Brazilian majority state-owned oil and gas corporation
wiki.text: Petróleo Brasileiro S.A., better known by and trading as the portmanteau Petrobras, is a Brazilian majority state-owned multinational corporation in the petroleum industry, which is headquartered in Rio de Janeiro. The company's name translates to Brazilian Petroleum Corporation.

about: Woodside Energy is Australia's largest oil and gas company, producing LNG from the North West Shelf, Pluto and Scarborough developments, plus oil in the Gulf of Mexico and Trinidad and Tobago, and developing the Louisiana LNG project in the US. Headquartered in Perth, founded in 1954. It merged with BHP's petroleum business in 2022. Customers are LNG buyers in Asia and Europe. Listed on the ASX (WDS) and NYSE. Corporate brand with strong Australian sport and community sponsorship.

wiki.title: Woodside Energy
wiki.text: Woodside Energy Group Ltd is an Australian petroleum exploration and production company. Woodside is the operator of oil and gas production in Australia and also Australia's largest independent dedicated oil and gas company. It is a public company listed on the Australian Securities Exchange and has its headquarters in Perth, Western Australia. In the 2025 Forbes Global 2000, Woodside was ranked as the 494th-largest public company in the world.
